not_used.Data/dataset.sqlite 'dataset_2012-26': only 548 rows for 2025-26 (540 regular through 2026-01-07 + 8 playoff rows); is_playoff/series columns incomplete, so playoff rounds were derived from the game log instead.
not_used.OddsData 'series_state_2025-26': only 4 rows, with inconsistent dates/labels; not used.

not_used.TeamData '*_playoff' tables: last snapshot is 2026-05-28 (pre-Finals), so playoff PF/PA/W-L come from the game log.

conventions.Spread: home-referenced closing line as stored by the pipeline: positive = home favored by that many points. Per-team 'avg_closing_spread_as_favorite' = mean points laid; 'as_underdog' = mean points received (both reported as positive numbers).
conventions.ATS: team covers iff (team margin - team spread) > 0; push iff == 0. Records are cover-push-loss. Regular-season league totals include each game once from the home perspective.
conventions.over_under: over iff Points > OU; push iff equal. Record is over-under-push.

phases.regular: Date <= 2026-04-12 (1230 games; NBA Cup Final on 2025-12-16 excluded and reported separately)

conventions.point_diff: point_diff_per_game = (PF - PA) / GP; regular-season point_diff_total is season sum.
